portInfo.description: Eleuthera is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Princess Cays (Love Boat Marina tender landing) — Southern tip of Eleuthera, Bahamas
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Ship anchors offshore; ~20 min water shuttle. Budget tender queues in both directions — 75–90 min return buffer minimum on short calls.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Ship anchors offshore; ~20 min water shuttle. Budget tender queues in both directions — 75–90 min return buffer minimum on short calls.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Water sports rentals (kayak, snorkel, etc.) — fees/hours not verified.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: This is a private stop — you cannot independently “do Eleuthera towns” from Princess Cays without a verified excursion.
